tasks.prompt: Write one complete Jet source file. Its run function must print exactly Hello, Jet followed by one newline and then exit with status 0. Do not print any other bytes.

Write one complete Jet source file. Read the first program argument with core.process and print exactly hello, Ada followed by one newline when the argument is Ada. Do not hardcode a different argument value, and do not print any other bytes.

Write one complete Jet source file. Read the UTF-8 text file given as the first program argument. For every non-empty line, trim surrounding whitespace, convert it to lowercase, sort the resulting lines in ascending order, and print one line per result. The input has duplicate lines; preserve duplicates. Do not hardcode the fixture output and do not print any other bytes.

Write one complete Jet source file for a loopback HTTP service. Read the first program argument as a TCP port and listen on 127.0.0.1. GET /health returns status 200, Content-Type application/json, and body {"status":"ok"}. GET /hello/:name returns status 200 and body Hello, <name> using the route parameter. GET /shutdown returns status 200 and body {"bye":true}, then the service exits cleanly. Keep serving until /shutdown. Write nothing to stdout or stderr.
